description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cid (IV)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Weapon in Progress (0~2), removed after using Weapon in Progress two times

description.name: Weapon in Progress Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Weapon in Progress level by 1 after dealing 100001 or 300001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cid (IV)]

description.name: Weapon in Progress Level
description.text: Keeps track of Weapon in Progress level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Cid (IV)]
